_doc: Vesting schedules for non-public pools. These are enforced off-chain by holding the locked KRN in a multisig and releasing per schedule. The protocol does NOT enforce vesting in v1.0-rc; on-chain balances appear immediately spendable. A future protocol amendment may add native vesting enforcement.

early_contributors.recipient: Foundation-managed pool, individual schedules per recipient

validator_bootstrap.recipient: Foundation-managed pool, distributed to early validators
